summary: One V's character runtime in one scene (her details, rig and motion state), one per V and scene, so two Vs can be shown at once with independent histories.

x-friction.gap: Today one character runtime serves whichever V is shown; each V needs its own, made when a view shows her and collected shortly after none does.
x-friction.closes: Host objects made per key of nodes on first demand, counted by demand, and collected after a linger.
